description: This file defines a FixturePool class and related functions for managing test fixtures in a testing framework, including fixture registration, dependency validation, and error handling.

classes.name: FixturePool
classes.description: Manages registration, validation, and resolution of test fixtures, including dependency cycle detection and error reporting.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the FixturePool with fixture definitions, handling overrides and dependencies.

methods.name: _appendFixtureList
methods.description: Adds fixtures from a list to the pool, handling options and dependencies.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates fixture dependencies for cycles and scope correctness, returning a hash of the pool state.

methods.name: validateFunction
methods.description: Validates fixture function parameters against registered fixtures.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a fixture name to its registration, considering overrides.

methods.name: _addLoadError
methods.description: Records a load error with message and location.
